solutions.title: Bit counts modulo three
solutions.strategy: Count set bits at each 32-bit position and keep positions whose count is not divisible by three.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are 32 fixed bit positions, and each position scans all n values.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only counters and the reconstructed result are stored.

solutions.title: Two-mask state machine
solutions.strategy: Track bits seen once and twice; the third sighting clears the bit from both masks.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each value updates the two masks once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The state is held in two integer masks.
